name: Collection banner
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Collection banner. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Collection
settings.how: Choose an existing collection. Manage its products, title, image, and description under Products > Collections.

settings.label: Allow custom banner without collection
settings.how: Turn on “Allow custom banner without collection” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
